calls.question: Safety car on lap 59. Box or stay out?

options.label: Box him
options.note: Fresh tyres for a cheaper stop, and the places it costs to take it.

options.label: Stay out
options.note: Keep the track position and run the old set to the flag or the next window.

calls.reading: 3 of 18 cars boxed under it. His garage kept him out: P10 when it came out, P10 three laps after the restart. The other road cannot be measured: a stop under a safety car is paid in track position, not in seconds.
